name: Tailscale Monitor
description: See your tailnet at a glance — every machine with address, OS, exit-node role, and live online status. Reads the local Tailscale daemon (tailscale status) — no API key or login needed.

options.label: tailscale CLI path
options.help: Leave blank to auto-detect (C:\Program Files\Tailscale\tailscale.exe). Set only if Tailscale is installed somewhere unusual.

options.label: Refresh interval
options.help: How often the machine list is polled from the local daemon.
